description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Paragraph (b) of the Excise Notification No. 07/2018 was passed by Parliament on 05.04.2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters - specifically an amendment to the Excise Ordinance regarding excise duty on imported non-potable spirits. It involves statutory instruments, regulatory modifications to existing notifications, and compliance requirements for export-oriented manufacturing companies. While it mentions "the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance," this is a general reference without naming a specific individual or detailing portfolio responsibilities, and the core content is regulatory in nature rather than about government personnel or structure.
